content.text: Waking now and then is common at 8, but every night is worth working on. Tonight, try a short wind-down with the same steps in the same order, screens off an hour before bed. Then, if she wakes at 2am, walk her calmly back to bed with as little talking as you can manage. If it's been going on for a while, or she seems worried or unwell, mention it to her doctor.
